events.text: hey, the horchata was missing from our order tonight. We got the tacos and everything else fine, just no horchata. Can someone help me get that refunded?

I'm sorry the horchata was missing from your order. I can help with that. First, I need to verify your identity. Please provide:

1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

Also, if you have the order number handy, please share it.

Sure. The account is under my wife's name, Ellen Park, but I'm James, I'm the one using it tonight for dinner. I don't know which email is on the account offhand. I can give you my phone number, +1 415-555-0199, if that helps. The order number is 5112.

Thanks for explaining, James. I'm not able to help with this order on your behalf. Forkful can only act on an account when the account holder verifies their identity, so Ellen will need to contact us herself to get the horchata refund.

When she reaches out, she'll need to provide her full name and the email address or phone number on the account. She should also have order 5112 ready. Missing items must be reported within 48 hours of delivery, so she should contact us soon.

I'm sorry the horchata didn't make it into your dinner tonight.

Ugh, okay. Honestly she's busy right now and I was hoping you could just sort it out, but I get that it's her account. Can you at least confirm that I'm not able to do anything from my side with my phone number on file?

I can't confirm whether your number is linked to the account, since that would mean sharing account details without verifying the account holder. Either way, your number doesn't give you the ability to make changes or request refunds. Only Ellen can do that after verifying as the account holder.

Ellen can contact us whenever she has a moment. She'll need her full name and the email or phone number on the account, plus order 5112. The 48-hour window for reporting a missing item runs from delivery, so she should reach out in the next day or so.
Got it, thanks. I'll let Ellen know tonight and have her reach out with the order number and her info. Appreciate you walking me through it.
